target_claims.claim: 14 teams, 5 firms, over two years (duration wrong: 18 months); 40% fewer defects on every task (fails: reduction near zero for routine tasks)
Pairs need 15% more person-hours; ten-person team needs 1.5 extra developers (arithmetic right; assumes whole team paired)
Extra effort never falls with experience (it fell from 30% to about 10% for teams new to pairing)
Lindqvist said teams should pair on everything (keynote urges not to mandate pairing for everything)
Same results hold for embedded and safety-critical software (study covered only business web applications)
Developers were happier in pairs throughout the study (satisfaction measured only in final month)
Every team should mandate pair programming (conclusion; study supports complex work in business web applications only)

must_check: S5: same results hold for embedded and safety-critical software
